rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: ClickUp's official MCP server enables AI assistants to interact with ClickUp workspace data including tasks, lists, folders, and docs using natural language. Currently in public beta, it supports OAuth 2.1 authentication and provides tools for task workflow orchestration, executive reporting, time tracking, and collaborative features across comments and chat. The server wraps ClickUp's existing API and supports major MCP clients like ChatGPT, Claude Desktop, VS Code, and Cursor, making it useful for automating project management workflows, generating status reports, and integrating ClickUp data into AI-powered productivity tools.
